sentences.en: Health advocates have pushed for laws restricting work-place smoking.
sentences.zh: 健康倡导者推动制定了工作场所禁止吸烟的法律。

sentences.en: He advocated to us that the changes be made.
sentences.zh: 他向我们提倡要进行这些改变。

sentences.en: China is an advocate for the Diaoyu Islands' sovereignty.
sentences.zh: 中国是钓鱼岛主权的倡导国。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ad（加强）+voc（喊叫）+ ate （做）→大声喊→提倡
